generated_at.description: UTC time when this file was built. Status values were decided at this clock.

id.description: Stable id. app:{uuid}:{asset}, tg:{message}:{asset}, or meta:{market}:{coin}.

asset.description: Ticker as written in the source. HIP-3 bases are the name before the quote, so GOOGLE stays GOOGLE when the post says GOOGLE-USDT.

dex.description: HIP-3 dex short name such as hyna or cash. Null on the main perp dex.

market_name.description: Pair label from a HIP-3 sunset post, such as BTC-USDE.

status.description: scheduled: the stated time is still in the future and the post was not postponed or confirmed. delisted: a later post confirmed it, a quorum time was reported, or info meta has isDelisted true on the latest schedule. postponed: a post postponed the delist and meta does not show it delisted. unconfirmed: the stated time passed, meta does not show isDelisted, and no confirmation post was found. superseded: a later schedule exists for the same asset. elapsed: a HIP-3 window has started and the meta coin could not be matched. relisted: a confirmation exists but meta currently has isDelisted false.

vote_time.description: Validator vote time stated in the announcement. Null when the post scheduled a delist directly.

vote_time_approximate.description: True when the source said around or approximately.

effective_time.description: Set only when a source states when the delist takes effect: a direct schedule, a corrected clock, a reported quorum time, or the start of a HIP-3 wind-down. Validator votes otherwise leave this null. The usual settlement rule is the one-hour oracle TWAP before the vote, which is not a single timestamp.

effective_time_end.description: End of a HIP-3 wind-down window when the post states one. Individual markets inside the window are not assigned their own hour.

settlement.description: Settlement method only when the source text states it. Older votes that do not say how positions settle are null.

api_coin.description: Coin name in info meta when it matched. Null when it did not, including GOOGLE versus cash:GOOGL.
